evidence.finding: Workspaces use Git worktrees; Changes panel shows diffs, commits and pull requests. Users create/merge PRs or merge locally; agents monitor comments/CI. Home groups Needs you, Running and Done/idle workspaces and exposes fleet navigation.

evidence.title: Intent agent runtime
evidence.locator: Agents & Chat; Terminal; Browsers; Token Savings
evidence.finding: Multiple concurrent workspace agents expose streaming output, stop/follow-up controls, provider quota failover, saved scripts and browser verification. Structured screenshots include accessibility trees and console output. Token view filters by agent/model; costs require provider reports. Daemon hooks and PR monitors wake agents on changes.

evidence.title: Intent remote setup
evidence.locator: intentd; pairing; web app; security and limits
evidence.finding: Background service runs on user-controlled Linux, Mac or Windows hosts. Desktop/iOS clients pair using bearer tokens and TLS fingerprints. Web app can run on a VPS behind private HTTPS; browser access uses an access key. Web app stores machine tokens in plain text. Rotating pairing token revokes old access.

evidence.title: Intent workspace transfer
evidence.finding: Transfer includes Git repo, notes, conversations and assets with WIP snapshot; agents stop first and may restart at destination. Event history, terminal sessions and server settings stay on source. iOS supports messages, tasks, diffs, terminals and offline reading.

evidence.title: Intent shared-workspace authorization
evidence.locator: capability.rs membership gates; intent-core/src/caller.rs and host_membership.rs; intent-transport/src/router.rs agent.sendMessage and protocol.rs lines 540-587
evidence.finding: The daemon implements separate human principals, workspace membership and role-based permissions. Invited collaborators can send agent messages in their workspace, with sender attribution, while host settings and other administration remain restricted. This is implemented sharing, not the future protocol-only extension.

evidence.title: Intent sharing controls
evidence.finding: The frontend exposes a host-admin Enable Sharing control and workspace sharing/invitation UI. Multiplayer is available in the client rather than being a disabled mock setting. Current release notes also describe invitations using GitLab accounts.

evidence.title: Intent anonymous update statistics controls
evidence.finding: The Share anonymous update statistics setting disables the Intent update-counting endpoint and selects the direct GitHub release feed. DO_NOT_TRACK also selects the direct feed. This scopes the control to desktop update statistics.

evidence.title: Intent authentication implementation
evidence.locator: auth.rs, invite.rs, source-control identity proofs and settings; searched SAML, OIDC, enterprise SSO
evidence.finding: The inspected daemon implements local/paired bearer credentials and GitHub/GitLab identity proofs for collaboration. It has no enterprise identity-provider SAML/OIDC SSO configuration. Forge sign-in is distinct from enterprise workspace SSO.

evidence.title: Intent workspace execution boundary
evidence.locator: sandbox_ops and agent execution; inspected runtime and settings for Docker/container/VM allocators
evidence.finding: Intent workspace isolation is a host Git worktree or direct folder. The scoped runtime starts coding providers as host processes and supplies no container/VM isolation allocator. Running intentd on a user VM is remote-host placement.
